cases.name: Tracy Melinda Lightburn-Martinez
cases.about:
She was born in Belize. Her obituary said, "Tracy moved to Los Angeles, CA at age 3 and later to Fontana, CA where she attended Cypress Elementary School and then on to Fontana High School. Tracy later earned her pharmacy technician license.

Tracy worked at Kaiser Permanente Hospital for 15 years until her passing. She enjoyed spending time with her family and friends, and reading and quoting her favorite verses from the bible."
cases.narrative: She told police with one of her last breaths that Anthony Graziano, her estranged husband, had shot her during a domestic dispute. They were in his Nissan Frontier on Cypress Avenue when she bolted from the car, and he chased her down and shot her dead.
